t: A square 12-core Arm computer board built for desktops, local AI, and development.
steps: Buy the board from Arace Tech or Allnet China. Stock was sold out at last check, and the 16 GB model listed at about 329 US dollars.
Get a 12 V power supply rated 65 W or more with a barrel plug.
Install an NVMe drive in one of the M.2 slots.
Download the Debian image from the Radxa docs.
Follow the Radxa getting started guide to write the image to your drive.
Connect a screen, a keyboard, a mouse, and a network cable, then power on.
Install VS Code and run a short Python script to test your setup.
Add a camera module and try the CIX NPU examples next.
